name: Gästehaus Rettenbacher
beschreibung:
Quietly yet centrally located in Fulpmes, Gaestehaus Rettenbacher is a popular address for outdoor holidaymakers. Well-maintained rooms and warm personal care ensure a thoroughly pleasant stay.

The Schlick 2000 ski resort, the StuBay leisure pool, and the Stubai Glacier are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Rettenbacher in Fulpmes offers family hospitality and relaxation in the Stubai Valley.
